svg.text: In VR the hands do the algebra
Both hands, both pans: the gesture that helps learning last (Cook, Mitchell & Goldin-Meadow 2008); the altar comes to the child, who stands still
each hand lifts a gem off its own pan at the same time;
the two vanish with a chime and a buzz in both hands
pull bowls from the rack (one pull, one bowl), then
press the altar's seal; the pans sort themselves into
in the Sky Room take a gem from the bag in each hand and
drop one on each pan; gem and balloon float off together
